name: Founder / craftsperson origin story

hook.visual: Founder in the place of work, mid-action — not desk TED talk
hook.audio_or_vo: The year / the bet / the non-obvious reason they started
hook.pattern_interrupt: A surprising constraint or unpopular belief

beats.visual: Archive photos, early shop, failed attempts
beats.vo_or_copy: Personal stake, not corporate mission statement

beats.purpose: The craft standard they refused to drop
beats.visual: Close-ups of process that competitors skip
beats.vo_or_copy: One non-negotiable that explains the price or wait

beats.visual: Customer handoff or finished work in the world

cta.on_screen: Watch the full story / Visit the shop / Start a project
cta.spoken_or_caption: If that standard matters to you, here’s how we begin
cta.landing_promise: About/process page that continues the same story

visual_system.camera: Observational documentary; shallow depth on craft details

why_it_works: Trust transfers from person to brand
Performs well as organic content that can be boosted

prompt_seeds.script: 45s first-person origin. Hook = unpopular craft belief. Show process they won’t skip. End with who it’s for.
prompt_seeds.shot_list: Founder action → archive → process close-ups → customer outcome → soft CTA

source_notes: Brand-building pattern for craft and local service businesses.
